stories.title: SK Hynix bargains for chip equipment exports to its China facility in return for building a factory in US
stories.description: SK Hynix’s Solidigm is reportedly seeking U.S. approval to send more chipmaking equipment to China as it weighs building a new NAND chip factory in America.

stories.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
stories.description: Trump said some would "rather not watch" the killing of Nidal Hasan, the first military execution in over 60 years.

stories.title: Russell Brand accuser says he turned 'monster-like' before alleged rape
stories.description: The 51-year-old faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

stories.title: Trans people should use hospital spaces according to biological sex, NHS England says
stories.description: New guidance says trans patients should be cared for on single-sex hospital wards or bays that align with their biological sex.

stories.title: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
stories.description: Jeffrey Donaldson was convicted of 18 counts of sex abuse, including one of rape, which he committed against two women when they were children.

stories.title: Inside the race between Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos for control of outer space
stories.description: The Atlantic writer Josh Tyrangiel says Musk and Bezos each want to colonize the moon, mine its resources and launch thousands more satellites. He says their only real competition is each other.

stories.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric

stories.title: Pope Leo resumes work in hospital while recovering from surgery

stories.title: DR Congo protests Formula 1’s ‘indefensible’ decision to race in Rwanda
